# Original Fibonacci256 Voronoi stencil

Author: Jason Coon (`jasoncoon`), Evil Genius Labs.
Source: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4191326
Board: https://www.evilgeniuslabs.org/fibonacci256

Bryan supplied the original Thingiverse ZIP. The original STL, README and license in this directory are
unchanged. LICENSE.txt contains the supplied Creative Commons Attribution notice.
The original STL is 2 mm thick. The native CAD extracts the STL bottom boundary at that same
thickness. It registers the pattern with the published 166 mm board by reversing
source X and centring it at (83, 83) mm. The original open edge cells remain open.
Do not replace this profile with a generated Voronoi pattern.

The separate rim spacers and the 250 mm front sheet belong to this enclosure.
They are not part of the original stencil. Print the stencil flat in opaque black
PETG. Check registration, complete thin walls and fit on the actual board before
ordering the complete assembly.

The ZIP also includes a DXF with an extra 0.567 mm² opening. That file does
not exactly match the original STL. The production model uses only the STL,
with 222 contours: one outside contour and 221 enclosed holes. The native
volume check compares the complete extrusion with the supplied STL.
